home_page.faq_question_1: 01. What fields does the Booking KOLs ecosystem support partners/customers in?
home_page.faq_answer_1:
The Booking KOLs ecosystem supports partners/business owners in the following fields: 
(i) Managing entire booking campaign operations, ranging from large to small scales, including Booking - KOLs/KOC Coordination - Strategic deployment advisory. 
(ii) Advising and providing e-commerce services in Vietnam & other countries worldwide (US/UK, etc.) for e-commerce platforms such as TikTokShop/Shopee.
home_page.faq_question_2: 02. Benefits of Cooperation with the Booking KOLs Ecosystem for Brands and Business Owners?
home_page.faq_answer_2:
Recognizing the challenges faced by brands and business owners, the Booking KOLs ecosystem provides three solutions to enhance efficiency in every KOLs/KOCs connection: 
(i) Access to a diverse list of suitable KOLs/KOCs nationwide and internationally, spanning various fields such as F&B, beauty, fashion, lifestyle, and entertainment. 
(ii) Management of collaboration mechanisms with KOLs/KOCs, ensuring mutual benefits with legal transparency to mitigate unnecessary risks. 
(iii) Comprehensive advice and guidance on campaign implementation, along with dedicated support throughout the cooperation process, offering detailed reporting data, effectiveness levels, and commitments made.
home_page.faq_question_3: 03. Why Collaborate with the Booking KOLs Ecosystem for KOLs/KOCs?
home_page.faq_question_4: 04. Conditions & Benefits for Talent within the Booking KOLs Ecosystem?
home_page.faq_answer_4:
Individuals passionate about self-development in the fields of art, creativity, and business can register to become  talent KOLs/KOCs within the ecosystem. Upon approval, they enjoy four special benefits: 
(i) Priority in receiving job/collaboration opportunities from brands/partners. 
(ii) Comprehensive training in Digital E-commerce & Branding skills and knowledge. 
(iii) Support in building and developing communication channels upon meeting specific criteria. 
(iv) Access to the ecosystem's resources for personal development and improvement.
